    Profile

    Magnus used to live his life striving to become the best alchemist in the world, and he almost reached his goal. One day however, he quit his research and training. Ever since then, he's been living his life without any real passions, just using his natural calculative talent for gambling.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Male
    Height: 170cm
    Weight: 55kg
    Birthday: Nov 8
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunder Beast
    Likes: Predictions and calculations
    Hobbies: Taking naps
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 内匠靖明
